personality_one_liner: An intelligent, frictionless mobile hiring ecosystem where candidates meet AI-matched career opportunities and recruiters manage pipelines seamlessly.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm with comfortable touch targets and safe area protection.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tab bars
Apply translucent tinted base over scrolling card backdrops
dont's: Never blur form inputs or entire screens
Do not sacrifice WCAG contrast on text over glass

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure authentication supporting email/password with strict complexity, Google, and Apple sign-in.

states.loading: Centered spinner over warm parchment backdrop
states.empty: Clean sign-in card with social buttons
states.error: Inline validation banner with actionable fix guidance

screens.layout: Centered clean card form with email/password inputs requiring special characters and numbers, plus one-tap Google and Apple buttons.

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: Display AI-matched job opportunities with search bar, filters, and quick application access.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching job card dimensions
states.empty: Illustration of a magnifying glass with search reset CTA
states.error: Friendly error message with retry button

screens.layout: Sticky search header, horizontal category chips, vertical stack of job listing cards with AI match badges and sticky bottom tab bar.

screens.name: RecruiterVerification
screens.purpose: Verify recruiters via email, corporate phone, and domain ownership for trusted job posting.

states.empty: Prompt to input corporate email and domain
states.error: Domain mismatch alert with support link

screens.layout: Step-by-step verification wizard with input fields for corporate email, phone verification code, and DNS/domain check status.

screens.name: JobDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of job description, mandatory requirements, differentiators, and AI resume customization trigger.
screens.layout: Hero banner with company logo and gradient scrim, tabbed view (Description, Requirements, Differentiators), and sticky bottom Apply CTA.

screens.name: AiResumeGenerator
screens.purpose: Allow candidates to request AI-tailored resumes matching specific job criteria.

states.loading: Animated AI generation progress indicator with tips

screens.layout: Split section preview showing original profile vs. real-time AI optimized bullet points, skill match percentages, and export/apply buttons.

screens.name: RecruiterPipeline
screens.purpose: Manage selective hiring pipeline with customizable stages and candidate evaluation.

states.empty: No candidates in this stage illustration
states.error: Failed to sync pipeline data retry

screens.layout: Horizontal stage selector (Pre-screening, Review, Interview, Video Call, Assessment, Decision) with candidate cards showing score indicators.

screens.name: VideoRoom
screens.purpose: Private or collaborative video interview room with secure room codes and auto-expiration.

states.loading: Connecting to secure backend video node...
states.empty: Waiting for participants to join room

screens.layout: Full-screen video grid with floating controls (Mute, Camera, Chat, Leave), room code badge, and encrypted retention timer.

screens.name: PrivacyAndAudit
screens.purpose: Manage explicit consent, visibility controls, audit logs, and data/account deletion.
screens.layout: Grouped iOS settings style list with toggle switches for profile visibility, consent agreements, audit log viewer, and secure data wipe.

video_backdrop.alt: Job interview video call abstract background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement all 8 core screens for Vagas+ using React Native and Expo. Ensure strong auth with email (requiring special chars & numbers), Google, and Apple. Implement recruiter verification via email, phone, and corporate domain. Build the AI resume builder for candidates and customizable selection pipeline for recruiters. Include the secure video call room with room codes and auto-expiration, plus privacy controls (audit logs, explicit consent, and data deletion). Strictly adhere to iOS-Native Clean styling with warm botanical palette (#3B5249 primary, #FDFBF7 surface), 1px borders, smooth glassmorphism on headers/tabs, and WCAG AAA contrast.
